_note: Camera and layout for each shot, read off the clay blockout (animatic/frames). The blockout is the source of truth; these lines go into the v4 prompts ahead of the beats.
_room: The ball pit and play structure stand across the room from my table, about 9 m away: a long, low ball pit with blue padded walls runs along the front of a wide two-level play structure of yellow poles with red, orange and teal tubes; a short flight of green padded steps with yellow handrails climbs the front wall of the pit, right of centre, up to the structure's first deck. Party tables with pink tablecloths fill the floor between us.
S01: I am seated at my party table, eyes about 1.1 m above the floor; the table fills the bottom third of the frame, my two hands resting on it around a red-and-white soda cup at the bottom centre. The shot opens looking left across the room at the back wall, balloons and the far tables, then pans slowly right across the party tables until the ball pit and the play structure are in view, small and far across the room. Sarah walks in from the right, about 3 m away, and comes up beside my chair on the right.
S02: I stay seated. Sarah stands on the chair right beside me, so close that her head and shoulders fill the middle of the frame, her face at my eye level. She lifts the yellow paper crown up toward the camera until it fills the frame, and it comes down onto my head out of view; then she is close in front of me again, centred, the far room behind her.
S03: I stay seated. Sarah starts close and centred in front of me, then hops down and steps back to the left onto the carpet, about 1.5 m away, pointing back across the room; my view follows her a little to the right along the edge of my table. She ends about 2 to 3 m away beside the end of my table, the ball pit and the play structure small and far behind her at the upper left.
S04: I stay seated. Sarah walks away from me across the room toward the ball pit, getting smaller, the play structure and the pit far behind her. My view then turns left across my table to the far end of the room: the far doorway at the left, about 8 m away, where the mascot has just stepped in, small; my soda cup on the table at the lower right.
S05: I am seated at my party table, eyes about 1.1 m above the floor; the near edge of the table fills the bottom third of the frame the whole time. The shot opens looking left across the room: the mascot is small, about 8 m away, by the far doorway and the far tables. It walks a few steps closer, still far across the room, never nearer than about 5 m. The view then pans right along my table to Sarah, about 1 m away at the right-hand corner of the same table, half-hidden behind it; in the background beyond her, small and far, the play structure and the ball pit.
S06: I stay seated at my table; its near edge fills the bottom third of the frame. Sarah starts close at the right-hand corner of my table, then runs off toward the back of the room and is soon a small figure far away. My view turns a little left and settles looking across the room: the ball pit and the play structure small and far across the back of the frame, the mascot about 4 m away at the left with a child in purple, balloons over the tables, and one phone in my right hand rising into the lower right of the frame.
S07: I stay seated; the table edge fills the bottom of the frame. One phone in my right hand fills the lower right quarter of the frame, held upright. Above and left of it the room carries on as before: the mascot about 4 m away on the left with a child in purple, the ball pit and play structure small and far across the back of the room.
S08: I stay seated; the table edge fills the bottom of the frame. The phone starts in the lower right, then sinks out of the bottom of the frame as my view lifts to the ball pit across the room, about 9 m away. The pit, the green steps and the play structure stay small, across the middle band of the frame; Sarah and the boy are small figures, each about a tenth of the frame height, climbing the green steps.
S09: I stay seated; the table edge fills the bottom of the frame. The ball pit, the green steps and the play structure stay small and far, about 9 m away across the middle band of the frame. Sarah and the boy are small figures, each about a tenth of the frame height, at the top of the green steps. One phone rises into the lower right of the frame in my right hand and stays there; the far steps stay visible above and left of it.
S10: I stay seated; the table edge fills the bottom of the frame. One phone in my right hand fills the lower right of the frame the whole shot. Above and left of it, small and far, about 9 m away, the boy shoves Sarah off the top of the green steps into the ball pit. Both stay small figures, each about a tenth of the frame height.
S11: Seated at first, the table edge across the bottom of the frame and the phone in the lower right. The phone goes down onto the table and out of frame; I stand up and the view rises to standing height, about 1.7 m, looking across the pink party tables to the ball pit about 8 m away. Sarah and the boy are small in the balls across the room.
S12: I walk across the room toward the ball pit; the pit, the green steps and the play structure grow larger as I get closer. I stop at the pit's padded front wall just left of the green steps, my two hands on top of the wall, looking down into the balls about a metre below; the boy stands in the balls in front of me, the play structure rising above, a yellow slide coming down into the pit on the right.
